added: Optional demographics: setup step 3 asks each group's context (no names), participants may give an age range and gender before Q1 (both skippable), and the response list shows the group context (migration 0011). (#342)

Setup saves on step 1: Continue creates the review as a draft, Home shows it with "Continue setup" (reopens at the next step with what was entered), and Cancel asks in the page whether to keep the draft or discard it. (#339)

Next steps lists the areas the report bands Needs support or Needs urgent attention as tick boxes, plus Other, saved with the notes; one "Complete 3D Review", confirmed in the page, makes the whole review read-only with "This review is complete." (#338)
changed: Participants now read one privacy line, "Your responses are confidential.", on the survey welcome and in setup step 3, after a check that no name, email, IP address or device detail is stored with a response. (#337)
fixed: "Take the tour" opens the sample assessment on Collect, the stage it is actually in, so the first screen no longer says "Prepare this assessment" beside "Collecting responses". (#345)
Setup wizard survives a reload: once step 1 is saved the page URL names the draft, and a reload reopens it at the same step with what was typed (kept in this tab only). (#346)
On Collect, a group that reaches or passes its expected number reads "6 responded · 3 expected" instead of "6 of 3 responded"; below the expected number it still reads "n of N responded". (#344)
The participant review screen's final button now reads "Submit answers" and uses the shared primary button style. (#348)
The assessment header no longer shows a primary that links to the page you are on, and "Preview invitation" is the one primary on Permissions. (#349)
Understand: before any report exists "Build the results" is the one primary; "Choose a next step" steps back until the results are built. (#350)
The facilitator no longer gets a new participant link on every page view: the launch page, Collect and the survey page now reuse the survey's active link until it is revoked or expires. (#351)
Each share card now shows its QR code inline as soon as it has a link, with no show/hide toggle. (#352)
Setup refuses an "Active until" date in the past with "Pick today or later", and Collect shows "Closed on <date>" once that date has passed. (#353)
The build-results confirm now reads "Build results from N responses? Everyone with access can see them."; the project page keeps its Access codes and Workspaces explanations behind Learn more. (#354)
The kit-root integration harness now injects `collectLine`, so its 23 tests pass again after U46. (#355)
Sign out and Use another account never open a Cloudflare error page: both end the app and Cloudflare sessions in the background and land on the sign-in screen with an empty email field. (#330)
The project page and the assessment stage headers now show one heading, at most one short line and one primary action; the role line and tool explanations sit behind "Learn more". (#332)
Facilitators issue paper access codes on the survey Share card (count, preview, show once, print), and "Open access codes" no longer sends them to the legacy console. (#335)
Owners can delete an empty assessment from its settings: one-sentence dry run, confirmed in the page, then back to the project with "Assessment deleted." (#336)
Asking the docs what a viewer can do no longer suggests survey, code or notes changes a viewer cannot make; next steps now come from the same role table the server enforces. (#334)
After renaming a workspace or an assessment, the form now says "Saved · Undo" right beside it, and Undo puts the old name back and says "Undone". (#333)
On Understand, only one "Build the results" button shows at a time: the button hides while its confirm is open and comes back if you choose Not now. (#329)
Setup drafts: a viewer opening a setup link goes to the review, surveys a part-launched draft already added stay ticked ("Already added."), and viewer cards on Home say "Continue assessment". (#340)
The root-route test for invitation links now matches how the app handles them (they stay in the app), so the test suite passes again. No change for users. (#343)
A valid access code now opens the v3 survey (intro, review and submit, thank-you) instead of the legacy participant page. (#341)
